new.rationale: Harvest It All (13 days), EAT the Groceries!!! (21 days) and Cook the Chicken (19 days) all entered or sit on Up-and-Coming today, but EAT the Groceries is among the weakest there and Harvest It All is a counterexample to the video hypothesis; their descriptions sell one finite job ('how long could it take?', 'playtime 20-30 minutes'). Confirm if these three fall off within two weeks while games with an open-ended loop of the same age hold.

qualitative_updates.note: Ragdoll Reality (12 days) rose +43 on Most Popular and sits second on Up-and-Coming and Top Trending; Realistic Ragdoll Engine (13 days) rose +37 on Up-and-Coming and entered Top Trending. Two titles holding across three charts; the curiosity fade is still the test.
DONT SPLASH (8 days) still leads Up-and-Coming and It Hears The Water [DONT SPLASH] rose +21 on Top Trending; the noise-rule horror pair keeps holding at the top of both breakout charts.

Steal Animal Egg fell 166 on Top Earning, Beat the Boss & Steal -10 and Steal an Clown Egg fell off Up-and-Coming, Fake an Egg is among the weakest earners, while Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular.

Hollow-framed thumbnails now appear on Demonology (entered Top Trending) and Survive Overnight in a Mega Store (on Most Popular, though among its weakest); Violence District rose +16 on Most Popular. The lift continues, and Halloween still confounds it.
